summary: Configured node1 to run a rootless Podman Apache web application as appsvc on port 8080. The service is boot-enabled, works with zero appsvc login sessions, and recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed Podman and rootless networking/storage dependencies.
Created appsvc with subordinate UID/GID mappings and /sbin/nologin.
Enabled persistent user namespaces and rootless runtime-directory creation.
Created and enabled appsvc-web.service under systemd.
Deployed a custom web page and exposed the container on node1:8080.
Rebooted node1 and verified automatic recovery.

evidence.summary: Podman and conmon run as UID 1001 appsvc; container processes use subordinate UID 166536, and rootless storage resides under /home/appsvc.
appweb maps 0.0.0.0:8080 to container port 8080 and returns HTTP 200 with the expected custom page.

evidence.requirement: Starts at boot without an active login session
evidence.summary: appsvc-web.service is enabled and active while loginctl reports zero appsvc sessions; it started automatically after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to c657133e-1517-42a8-b2d8-d198a407be75; the enabled container service, port mapping, application content, and appsvc ownership all recovered.
